title: Speaking — Recovering from a busy week
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on recovering from a busy week.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
How do you know when you need to slow down?
What activity relaxes you after a busy week?

part2.topic: Describe a short break that helped you feel renewed.
points: what you left behind for a while
what you did during the break
part2.closing: and explain why it was effective.

questions: Why do some people have difficulty taking breaks from work?
What can organisations do to make taking time off more acceptable?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to recovering from a busy week?
